limitations: Observed metadata is not an atomic snapshot or active-agent lease.
No reflog-only/unreachable object sweep; protect those before pruning or GC.
Patch equivalence ignores merge topology and is never deletion proof.
No file contents, diffs, credentials, provider messages or remote URLs are emitted.
Ignored entries are data to preserve until explicitly classified, not automatic trash.
No fetch, prune, gc, checkout, stash, commit, branch deletion or worktree removal.
Candidates require a separate preservation plan and fresh owner-approved recheck.
